name: show-me-your-work
purpose: Keep a reviewable local decision trail for long-running or unattended work.
triggers: Work reviewed after a human steps away
inputs: This run transcript and reviewer capabilities
outputs: Attention section with observed reviewer model and flags or explicit gaps
ordinaryExample: Record a verified checkpoint and a reverted decision, resolve their evidence, audit this run and request an independent different-family reviewer.
capabilityLimits: The logging helper is present and reviewed; authorized execution, local persistence and readback still require observed host capabilities.
History, durable write and readback, and independent different-family review require observed authorized bindings.
Sequential self-review does not satisfy cross-model review.
No secrets or unsupported completion claims; commits and external actions need explicit authorization.
Host behavior remains not-run; disable-model-invocation metadata does not prove host enforcement.
